strings.name: Luis von Ahn
strings.summary: Von Ahn linked internet security with human computation, helping develop CAPTCHA and using reCAPTCHA to combine verification with digitizing texts. He later co-founded Duolingo with Severin Hacker, applying gamified learning to language education. After its flotation, the company expanded courses and testing; its AI-first strategy also drew public debate.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His CAPTCHA and crowdsourcing research and co-founding of Duolingo advanced internet security and online language education.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Mathematics bachelor's degree, Duke University (2000); computer science doctorate, Carnegie Mellon University (2005).
strings.highlights.h1.title: CAPTCHA and human computation
strings.highlights.h1.text: Helped develop CAPTCHA, later combining verification and text digitization through reCAPTCHA.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Co-founding Duolingo
strings.highlights.h2.text: Built a language-learning platform with Hacker, combining free courses and paid services.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Continuing to lead Duolingo
strings.timeline.t1.text: His 2026 shareholder letter identifies him as co-founder, CEO and board chairman.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Responding to AI-first criticism
strings.timeline.t2.text: After promoting an AI-first strategy, acknowledged in an interview that he had not anticipated the public backlash.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Duolingo flotation
strings.timeline.t3.text: The language-learning company listed on Nasdaq, entering its public-market phase.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Co-founding Duolingo
strings.timeline.t4.text: Founded the company with Severin Hacker to develop online language education.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Selling reCAPTCHA
strings.timeline.t5.text: Google acquired the verification company he had led since 2007.
strings.timeline.t6.title: MacArthur Fellowship
strings.timeline.t6.text: Received the fellowship and began as a Carnegie Mellon assistant professor.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completing a doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed his computer science doctorate at Carnegie Mellon.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduating from Duke
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned a mathematics bachelor's degree before moving into computer science research.
